text:
mia: Heads-up — ACME wants SOC2 report + signed pen-test attestation for the POC. They also asked for a small network diagram showing our SMTP relay and the IPs we use for external scans. POC scheduled for next Tue.

owen: Can we supply a signed pen-test letter? Who signs it from our side — legal or security?

leila: We can provide the SOC2 artifact bundle and a pen-test attestation template that our Security Head can sign. Note: we don't publish vendor full pen-test reports, only our attestation that a pen test occurred and high-level findings if releasable. :lock:

tony: Ops can provision a staging environment with static egress IPs for the window. Needs an infra ticket and ~24h lead time. Static IPs will add to costs.

mia: Customer wants a quick cost delta for single-tenant staging + reserved IPs for 2 weeks, and confirmation that presigned upload link is acceptable for evidence transfer.

owen: I'll calc the uplift and loop in sales-ops. Ballpark estimate first, final after infra specs.

leila: For evidence transfer, presigned S3 is the standard. Ops snippet to generate: 

aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/ACME_POC_bundle.zip --expires-in 3600

We will redact secrets and exclude KMS material. SSO/SAML and logging screenshots will be included in the bundle.

mia: Also need the name/title of the legal signer for the attestation so I can tell the customer who to expect.

proofpack-bot: proofpack created: https://docs.redwood.ai/proofpack/1759001234-ACME (contains SOC2 bundle, template attestation, and initial network diagram draft)

leila: I'll prepare the signed attestation (Security Head signature) and update the network diagram to show SMTP flow and egress ranges. Expect drafts by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:

tony: Opening infra ticket for static IPs now, will post the ticket link once created.

mia: Thanks — I will hold customer update until we have the draft attestation and the cost delta. Keep updates short in this thread.
